We need to generate test cases for the focal method toWire(DNSOutput). The method writes header and then iterates sections, skipping null sections, and for each record calls rec.toWire(out, i, c). So we need to cover branches: header.toWire always executed, loop over sections length, if sections[i]==null continue (branch). Also need to cover case where sections[i] non-null with records; also maybe empty list? The inner loop will not execute if list empty; but not a branch. So tests:

- Test when sections array all null: only header toWire called, no record toWire.

- Test when some sections null and some non-null with records: verify that records' toWire called with correct section index and compression object.

- Test when a section non-null but empty list: ensure no record toWire called.

- Also test that Compression object is same for all records (maybe verify same instance passed). Need to mock Record and Header.

3. Section non-null empty list -> header called, no record toWire.

4. Multiple sections non-null with records, ensure same Compression instance passed to each record.
